resources.string: Control Apple Music, Spotify and YouTube Music from one widget.
Start a song in a music app
No lyrics found for this song
Couldn\'t load lyrics. Check your internet and tap the lyrics button again.
Play a song to see lyrics
Android shares what\'s playing (and play/pause/skip controls) only with apps that have notification access. The widget reads nothing else.
Switch greyed out? Tap “Open app info”, then the ⋮ menu (top right) → “Allow restricted settings”, then try again. Android does this for apps installed from a file.
In App info, turn ON “Autostart” and set Battery saver to “No restrictions”. Otherwise HyperOS may stop the widget from updating.
Long-press your home screen → Widgets → Music Widget. Or use the button below. Resize it by long-pressing the widget and dragging its edges.
Your launcher can\'t add widgets this way. Long-press the home screen → Widgets instead.

Widget: tap album art to open the player panel.\nPanel: swipe art left/right = next/previous · double-tap = play/pause · tap or swipe up = lyrics · swipe down = close · drag the bar to seek · tap a lyric line to jump there · long-press an app icon to open that app.
